steps.text: Open a new doc and title it "Dashboard handoff".
steps.why: An empty doc with a title is an easy first move; the rest is filling it in.

steps.text: Add three headings: Done, Left to do, Where things are.
steps.why: Those are the three things the note needs; headings turn one big note into three short lists.

steps.text: Under Done, write one line per finished chart or report.
steps.why: One line each is enough: the next owner needs to know what exists, not how you built it.

steps.text: Under Left to do, list the open tasks and known bugs.
steps.why: Open work is what the next owner needs most, so it goes in even if the list is short.

steps.text: Under Where things are, paste the links to the files and data sources.
steps.why: Links save the next person from asking you where each file lives.

profileUsed.how: You prefer written instructions, so each step says exactly what to write.
